studentNote.title: Student Note
studentNote.description: Student uploaded study note document with metadata and extracted text

id.description: Unique identifier for the note document

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student who uploaded the note

ownerEmail.description: Email address of the student owner

filename.description: Original file name uploaded by the student

fileType.description: Normalized file extension: pdf, docx, or txt

extractedText.description: Parsed text extracted on the server from the document

wordCount.description: Total word count of extracted text

pageCount.description: Number of pages in PDF document (if applicable)

errorMessage.description: Detailed explanation if extraction or OCR requirement occurs

/students/{studentUid}/notes/{noteId}.description: Isolated per-student notes collection accessible strictly by the owning student
